flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: The biggest move in the Senate market is in [[Kansas]], where the Democrat Adam Hamilton saw a sizable rise in Polymarket odds, and the race is a predicted flip. The market also moved in [[Maine]], where the Democrat Troy Jackson gained ground in a race the market sees as a predicted flip. In [[Michigan]], the Democrat Abdul El-Sayed lost some ground.
summaries.governor: In [[Florida]], the Republican Byron Donalds saw a moderate drop in their chances, while in [[Oregon]] the Democrat Tina Kotek gained moderate ground. In [[Nevada]], the Democrat Aaron Ford edged up slightly in the Polymarket odds, and the market lists the race as a predicted flip.
summaries.house: The biggest move was in [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], where the Republican Brad Knott saw a moderate drop in the Polymarket odds against the Democrat Paul Barringer. In [[NY-17 (Spring Valley & Ossining)]], a predicted flip, the Democrat Cait Conley gained slight ground against the Republican Mike Lawler. The Republican Nick LaLota also edged up a little in [[NY-01 (Lake Grove & Port Jefferson)]], where the Democrat Chris Gallant is the other candidate.
